name: Hit the Mother Lode
oracle_text: Discover 10. If the discovered card's mana value is less than 10, create a number of tapped Treasure tokens equal to the difference. (To discover 10, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card with mana value 10 or less. Cast it without paying its mana cost or put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.)
blocked_sentences: If the discovered card's mana value is less than 10, create a number of tapped Treasure tokens equal to the difference.

needs.what: a `discover` op taking N: exile cards from the top of your library until a nonland card with mana value N or less is exiled, then let the player either cast it without paying its mana cost or put it into their hand, and put the rest on the bottom in a random order (701.57); it must bind the discovered card (`as`) so later effects can read it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cascade` takes `max_mana_value` but only offers cast-or-bottom (no put-into-hand choice), uses a strict 'less than' bound, and binds nothing; `reveal_until` has `selector`, `destination` and `rest_to_bottom` but no free-cast option, no cast-or-hand choice and no `as` binding; `look_at_top` has `cast_free` but looks at a fixed number of cards rather than exiling until a match

needs.what: reading the discovered card's mana value after it has been cast or moved to hand, so the follow-up can compute `minus(const 10, mana_value_of(binding discovered))` as the number of tapped `treasure_token`s, and do nothing when no card was discovered
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `mana_value_of` and `minus` exist but there is no binding to the discovered card for them to read, since no op in reference both performs the discover and records its result
